description.zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组。
description.en: The ID of the new resource group. You can view available resource groups in the resource group console.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the WAF resource to operate on.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh: 资源类型定义。固定取值：defenseresource
description.en: The resource type. Fixed value: defenseresource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi change-resource-group --resource-id demo.aliyun.com-waf --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2mcq000 --resource-type defenseresource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
